title: A new approach to the 2-regularity of the ℓ-abelian complexity of 2-automatic sequences
notes: Electron. J. Combin. 22 (2015), #P1.27. Proves that the 2-abelian complexity of the Thue-Morse and period-doubling words is 2-regular, via 2-block coding followed by abelian complexity of the block sequence. Poses the general conjecture that the k-abelian complexity of an ℓ-automatic sequence is ℓ-regular. The block-coding step is the literature mechanism the Phase-0 residual must not rediscover as new.
